raw.details:
ENIGMA 2.0 – 24-Hour Inter-College Hackathon

Organized by Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology (RIET), Jaipur.

ENIGMA 2.0 is an inter-college hackathon designed to bring together talented students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to solve real-world problems through technology and innovation.

This 24-hour offline hackathon will provide participants with an opportunity to collaborate, brainstorm ideas, develop innovative solutions, and showcase their technical skills.

The event focuses on emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, and other innovative technology domains.

Event Details

  • Event Name: ENIGMA 2.0

  • Organizer: Rajasthan Institute of Engineering and Technology (RIET), Jaipur

  • Date: 17–18 December 2026

  • Duration: 24 Hours

  • Mode: Offline

  • Venue: RIET Campus, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

  • Team Size: 2–4 Members

  • Registration Fee: ₹100 per participant

Prize Pool – ₹23,000

  • First Prize: ₹11,000

  • Second Prize: ₹7,000

  • Third Prize: ₹5,000

Additional rewards include certificates, trophies/medals, and goodies.

Eligibility

  • Open to college and university students.

  • Participants can register individually or as a team, subject to the platform's team registration rules.

  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.

  • Participants from different colleges are welcome.

Hackathon Format

  1. Participants register individually or in teams.

  2. Registered participants receive event-related updates and instructions.

  3. Problem statements and challenges will be provided at the venue.

  4. Teams work collaboratively to develop their solutions within 24 hours.

  5. Participants present their projects before the evaluation panel.

  6. Winners are selected based on innovation, technical implementation, problem-solving, and presentation.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Each participant must provide accurate registration details.

  • Teams must follow the prescribed team size.

  • Participants should bring their own laptops and required development tools.

  • Projects must be developed during the hackathon according to the event guidelines.

  • Plagiarism and misrepresentation of work are not permitted.

  • The decisions of the organizing and judging committees will be final.

Skills & Learning Opportunities

Participants will get an opportunity to enhance their problem-solving, teamwork, programming, innovation, and technical development skills.

Join ENIGMA 2.0 and transform your ideas into innovative solutions!

Official Website: https://www.enigmariet.com/

  • Open Payment Scanner (QR Code): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UfU49gDXyv1WDxBMhxcj51ZxrxY7QwjY/view?usp=drivesdk
  • Or Pay Directly on UPI ID: msdoppler.eazypay@icici
  • Team Payment: Pay combined fee for your entire team in one transaction (₹200 for 2 members, ₹300 for 3 members, ₹400 for 4 members).
  • Note: Upload your payment screenshot and 12-digit UTR ID in the registration form.
